method: Same nativeVision landmark measurement on all140 Q and S frames; compare observed eye position/roll/distance to each configured forward similarity matrix applied to Q landmarks. Mouth/eye contours normalized by eye distance, making uniform scale invariant.
limits: These are2D image landmarks, not skull motion or3D pitch/yaw measurements.
Exact20percent residual is a configuration target after smoothing; raw image landmark ranges include detection noise, blinks and high-frequency residual.
Eye-distance ratio is noisy during closed-eye frames; configured continuity and a visual size check should accompany it.
High mouth/eye contour correspondence supports preserved expression timing, not perfect perceptual lip sync.
Parent owns audio/decode/PTS checks; other agent owns edge artifacts. No media edits or gate changes.
